description: Scenario plausibility / GATE bounds (S3, design §9). 'bounds' are hard per-factor-class sanity caps and form the gate: a move beyond them is almost certainly an authoring error or runaway propagation -> FAIL -> held out of the run. 'envelope' is the n-sigma historical band (daily std from Σ scaled to the scenario horizon); stress moves are designed to exceed ordinary history, so a breach is by default a FLAG (recorded for review, still promotable). Per-tier 'severe_action'/'non_severe_action' (flag|fail|ignore) let a stricter desk make non-severe breaches gate.

market_implied._comment: B4 forward-looking check: grade each equity move against the option market's risk-neutral tail probability (from the RND, signal 5). ADDITIVE and FLAG-ONLY -- it records how extreme a shock is versus what the market prices but never gates a scenario out. No-op unless the marketdata option signals exist on disk. min_prob: flag an equity move the market prices below this probability. The option data is point-in-time to the run's as_of (options_sizing.json).
